name: tattoo-aurelia

hero_wash.verified: Render-proven 2026-08-13 on a themed local serve of this SSR donor: the first <section> under <main> carries /assets/hero-wash.* on every page; stripping it changes about 54 percent of the /portfolio title band and about 13 percent of /visit, headline on top. The HOME hero is a full-bleed IMG (hero-poster) that covers the wash, so it is a photo_slot for the client's own photo; the inner title bands wash visibly.

hero_wash_note: ON 2026-08-13. Multipage SSR (TanStack). The home hero is a full-bleed IMG; the six inner pages have title bands the wash paints. background and text_color are the raw dark sample (fallback only); the shipped scrim is the theme pass slab/slabInk. hero-poster is a photo_slot.
label: Aurelia
source: lovable:inkscribe-booking (67b5cad5) — published build ported; persona was FICTIONAL (AURELIA INK, 555 phone, example.com email), no real business identity ever existed in this donor
stack: TanStack Start (SSR) published build -> static per-route prerender + hydrating SPA chunks
donor_city_note: Deliberately blank. The persona's Austin is tokenized to {{CITY}} in every file; declaring 'Austin' as an identity atom would hard-fail any legitimate Austin prospect on the naive substring scan (the Tempe/temperature trap, wss-elconstruction-donor-blockers).
photo_slots_note: Six portfolio slots, filled with the PROSPECT'S own work. The donor originals are Lovable-generated illustrative images of a fictional studio — no real client's skin or real artist's portfolio is in this donor. The four process-XX images are instructional (station, stencil, machine, aftercare) and stay donor-supplied; the hero poster + loop are the cinematic layer and stay donor-supplied.

ladder: the client's own verified clip at client_video_path (engine-placed, mp4, magic-byte verified)
the WSS-owned clip at wss_fallback_clip_path (REAL bytes ship today: the donor-owned tattoo-studio reel, a 1743972-byte mp4; rung 2 plays on every build as-is)
the client's photograph — photo slot 1 (the hero img and the video poster attribute are the same file; the engine swaps the slot with the prospect's own photo)
the drawn ink-dark hero composition (grain overlay, vignette and scrim under everything)
hero_video.note: Owner's order, 2026-08-16: a source site with a hero video ships that video; the still photo rung is the emergency fallback, not the contract. The hero video element already carried the autoplay contract, a poster over a ken-burns still, and a Tailwind motion-reduce hide; the static <source> child and the onError display:none (which would strand the ladder after one failed rung) are gone, and the rungs are armed only by the hero-video-ladder runtime in index.html — a rung arms when its bytes shipped, an error steps down silently, and reduced motion never arms the video rungs. The engine writes an approved clip to client_video_path (mp4 only — the slot extension is binding); never a borrowed or fabricated clip.

media_note: Hero loop re-encoded from the source asset (7,715,020b 12.2Mbps -> 1,743,972b crf24 maxrate 2600k faststart), referenced from the router chunk as /media/hero-loop.mp4 (the CDN /__l5e/ URL is rewritten in JS, not just HTML).
spa_routes_note: Declared EXPLICITLY to keep deriveRoutes off the compiled router: with an empty list the engine reads the route table out of the JS bundle, which still registers the donor's dead Supabase /admin and /auth routes, and deep_link then 404s probing /admin. Every declared route ships its own prerendered index.html; the deep_link probe accepts a route serving its own page (the 40f6cb0 multi-page fix), and the donor ships its own cleanUrls vercel.json — the concrete-elconstruction lesson.

lead_endpoint.note: The donor's booking form posted to its own /api/public/booking (TanStack server fn + Supabase storage for reference images) — dead on a static mirror, and every lead would have vanished. The submit path in the router chunk is rewired: endpoint -> quote-request, payload mapped (style/size/placement join into `service`, description -> message), reference-image upload no longer required for submission. The reference-upload UI remains; attaching images is best-effort.

notes: Ported from the PUBLISHED build (site was born as a WSS donor template: src/config/siteConfig.ts is placeholder identity with explicit 'never ship this placeholder' markers, and src/config/presets.ts ships hairSalon/spa/barber/tutor presets for future lanes). Lovable badge, /~flock.js loader and og:image pointing at the lovable.app host are stripped; the inert window.__lovable* optional-chained error hooks remain (no script defines them, so they no-op). 348 identity replacements pass 1 + 145 pass 2, residual audit clean except a 'you@example.com' form input placeholder, kept deliberately.
hero_headline_2026_08_11: The home h1 was "Custom tattoos drawn for the body you are in." — the donor's sentence on every tattoo mirror. Now HERO_LINE_A + HERO_LINE_B, each the whole value of its own span so a blank can never weld to literal copy.

heroVideo.note: Video variant is default when the engine has a clip; poster hero serves otherwise.

engineInjectionPoint: ENGINE INJECTION POINT comment immediately before <footer>

identity.note: Donor-side identity atoms, declared so lib/mirror-engine/scan.js identityScan() builds a non-empty atom list. Never shipped: hydrate.js drops BOILERPLATE.json from the output tree.
